Level 17 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Expertise in a skill
Space: Vast
Hirelings: 1
Order: Recruit

A Guildhall comes with a guild of which you are the guild master. Choose a guild on the Sample Guilds table or create one with your DM. The facility is a meeting room where members discuss important matters in your presence. Your guild has about fifty skilled members who live and work outside your Bastion, usually in nearby settlements.

Recruit: Guild Assignment. Each Recruit order has the hireling gather guild members for a special assignment, as given by your guild on the table. With your DM's help, you can create other assignments.

GuildSymbolAssignment
Adventurers' GuildLit torchAdventurers track down a Beast of Challenge Rating 2 or lower known to lair within 50 miles of your Bastion and slay or capture it (your choice) in 1d6 + 1 days. A slain creature can provide a trophy for your Trophy Room; a captured one can join your Menagerie if it has room.
Bakers' GuildPastryBakers make baked goods for a prestigious event within the next 7 days. You're paid 500 GP or a favor owed by the event's host (details with your DM).
Brewers' GuildFoaming mugBrewers deliver fifty 40-gallon barrels of ale (10 GP each) to your Bastion in 7 days.
Masons' GuildStone maskMasons add a defensive wall to your Bastion at no cost, or to another character's Bastion within 1 mile of yours. Each 5-foot square of wall takes 1 day to build instead of 10.
Shipbuilders' GuildCrossed oarsShipbuilders build one vehicle from the Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles table of the Player's Handbook. You pay its full cost, and the work takes 1 day per 1,000 GP of cost (a Rowboat takes 1 day).
Thieves' GuildWhite keyThieves infiltrate a location within 50 miles of your Bastion and steal a nonmagical object no bigger than 5 feet in any dimension, delivered in 1d6 + 1 days. The DM may decide you risk retaliation from the law or the victim.
